question:
**Direction: Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option ‘no correction required’ if the sentence is correct as given.**

He was pleased to see them, especially as (**Alice was disposed off to**) be sympathetic rather than critical.
solution:
The correct answer is "Alice was inclined to."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
__
 
• In this context, **"disposed off"** is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase is **"disposed to"** or **"inclined to,"** both of which mean having a tendency or inclination towards something. (सही वाक्यांश "disposed to" या "inclined to," है, दोनों का अर्थ किसी चीज़ के प्रति प्रवृत्ति या झुकाव है।)
 
• Among the provided options,** "Alice was inclined to"** is the best fit and maintains the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

Correct sentence: *He was pleased to see them, especially as **Alice was inclined to**__ be sympathetic rather than critical.*
